methods.label: Check the longest side
methods.explanation: In A, \(3+4>5\), and the longest side, 5, is less than the sum of the other two sides. In B, \(2+3=5\); in C, \(1+2<4\); and in D, \(4+4<9\), so none of these can form a triangle.
methods.levelReason: The elementary triangle inequality and small-number addition are sufficient.
